actions.description: The Pixie magically grants a creature it can see a Flying speed of 30 feet. The creature keeps its Flying speed, as long as the Pixie is holding its breath. The Pixie can hold its breath for a number of minutes equal to 1 + its Constitution modifier (minimum of 30 seconds). The Pixie can only grant this effect to one creature at a time, and when the effect ends, it must wait 1 minute before using it again.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Postal Knight makes two melee attacks or three attacks with its Sling.

bonus_actions.name: Defensive Cooking
bonus_actions.description: When wielding a frying pan, the Postal Knight can gain a +1 bonus to AC until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Brother in Arms
reactions.description: If damage is dealt to a friendly creature within 5 feet of the Postal Knight, the Postal Knight and the target each take half of the damage dealt, splitting the damage between them.

name: Rubble Golem
damage_immunities: piercing from nonmagical attacks that aren
slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The golem’s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Collapse
actions.description:
Recharge 5–6. The golem targets a 15-foot-diameter circle within 15 feet of itself. Each creature in the area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be crushed as the golem leaps and lands in the designated location, turning into a shockwave of rubble and transforming into its rubble form. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (5d8) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn’t knocked prone.

While the golem is in rubble

:
- The area of impact is difficult terrain.
- The golem is incapacitated and has resistance to all damage.
- It automatically fails Dexterity saving throws.

The golem returns to its original form at the start of its next turn, shunting any creature in its space to an unoccupied space within 5 feet.

traits.name: Entangling Form
traits.description: A creature that touches the Seaweed Elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or become Restrained by the elemental. At the start of each of the Restrained creature’s turns, it takes 5 (1d10) bludgeoning damage. The Restrained creature can use its action to repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. If the elemental moves more than 10 feet away from the creature, the effect ends.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: If the Seaweed Elemental is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. If a creature hasn
t ordinary seaweed.

traits.name: Mostly Clumps
traits.description: The Seaweed Elemental can move through a space as narrow as 5 inches wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes two Slam attacks.

traits.name: Rush
traits.description: If the sheep dragon moves at least 20 feet in a straight line, during which it moves within 5 feet of a creature and flies past it, that creature must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pulled 10 feet in the direction the sheep dragon is moving and knocked prone, and the sheep dragon doesn’t provoke an opportunity attack from it. On a successful save, the creature isn’t pulled or knocked prone, and if it makes an opportunity attack against the sheep dragon, it does so with disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sheep dragon makes two
: one with its Bite and one with its Headbutt. Alternatively, it makes three Wind Pistol attacks.

traits.name: Shrapnel
traits.description: If a creature within 5 feet of the swarm hits it with a melee attack while the swarm isn’t underwater, the creature must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature flinches, giving it disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes this turn.

traits.name: Skeletonized
traits.description: The swarm doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny fish. The swarm can’t regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.target: one target in the swarm’s space
actions.hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer

traits.name: Cloud Trail
traits.description: Wherever the Sky King flies, it creates a trail of giant fluffy white clouds in its wake.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.description: If the Sky King fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.description: Unless it wishes to be affected, the Sky King is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The Sky King

traits.name: New Life
traits.description: When the Sky King dies, a new great beast is born into the world.

traits.name: Spirit of Obojima (1/Day)
traits.description: If the Sky King drops below 150 hit points, a giant storm begins to brew above and the oceans become uneasy. For the next minute, creatures that touch the Sky King or hit it with a melee attack take 9 (2d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Sky King makes three
: two with its Chomp and one with its Tail.

actions.name: Inspiring Presence
actions.description: Each creature of the Sky King’s choice within 300 feet that can see or hear it gains inspiration and a flying speed of 30 feet for 1 minute. Once a creature benefits, it can’t again for 7 days.

legendary_actions.description: The Sky King can take 5 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The Sky King regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.description: The Sky King makes a Chomp attack.

actions.name: Turbulent Shift (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: The air or water surrounding the Sky King spins violently. Each creature within 60 ft. (except the Sky King) must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and is disoriented until the end of its next turn (disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws). On a success, the creature takes half damage and isn

actions.name: Nullify (Costs 3 Actions)
actions.description: All spells of 3rd level or lower within 120 feet are suspended (as per Antimagic Field) until the start of the Sky King

traits.name: Color Shift
traits.description: Jumaga naturally changes color to blend into its environment, giving it advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide from creatures that are more than 300 feet away.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Jumaga fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: Jumaga

traits.name: New Life
traits.description: When Jumaga dies, a new great beast is born into the world.

traits.name: Spirit of Obojima (1/Day)
traits.description: If Jumaga drops below 200 hit points, it glows a bright orange for 1 minute. During that time, its Chomp deals an extra 5 (1d10) poison damage on a hit, and it regains 5 (1d10) hit points each time it is targeted by a spell of 3rd level or lower.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Jumaga makes three
: two with its Chomp and one with its Tail.

actions.name: Paralyzing Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Jumaga exhales a paralyzing breath in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary_actions.description: Jumaga can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. Jumaga regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

actions.name: Tail Attack
actions.description: Jumaga makes a Tail attack.

actions.name: Skin Toxins (Costs 2 Actions)
actions.description: Jumaga’s body secretes a dangerous toxin. Until the start of its next turn, creatures that touch it or hit it with a melee attack take 16 (3d10) poison damage.

actions.name: Bestial Hiss (Costs 3 Actions)
actions.description: Jumaga produces a thunderous hiss. Each creature within 150 feet must succeed on a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw or be Pacified until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Heat Wave
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the Slagger takes 2 (1d4) fire damage. If the creature is wearing metal armor or wielding metal weapons, the damage is doubled.

traits.name: Scorch
traits.description: Flammable objects ignite if they come within 15 feet of the Slagger.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Slagger uses its Cough. It then makes one Slam attack.

actions.name: Spew Magma (Recharge 5–6)
actions.hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) fire damage. Regardless of whether the attacks hit or miss, the area within 5 feet of each target is covered in lava. The lava is considered difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in the lava takes 6 (1d12) fire damage. The lava cools and hardens after 1 minute, at which point it becomes harmless and is no longer difficult terrain.

actions.name: Cough
actions.description: The Slagger coughs a sulfurous cloud in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 13 (2d12) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The green slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Flee
actions.description: To save itself from danger, the green slime can sever off a part of its body to cause a distraction. The slime chooses to lose any number of hit points when using this ability. For each hit point lost, a tiny copy of the slime leaps from its body and moves 30 feet in a random direction, after which it falls lifeless.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The Yellow Slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Horrid Stench
traits.description: When a creature starts its turn within 20 feet of the Yellow Slime, it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be gagged by the terrible smell. On a failed save, the creature must use all of its movement to move away from the slime by the safest available route.

traits.name: Sticky
traits.description: If the Yellow Slime doesn’t move for a round, the space it occupies becomes slathered in a sticky, acrid yellow coating. For all creatures except Oozes, the space is difficult terrain, and when the creature enters or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 4 (1d8) acid damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Yellow Slime makes one Spike attack and uses its Arrange.

actions.name: Arrange
actions.description: The Yellow Slime attempts to pull a creature within 5 feet through its body into another space. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or take 4 (1d8) acid damage and be moved to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the slime.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The Orange Slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Explosive
traits.description: If the Orange Slime takes fire damage, a portion of its body explodes. Each creature within 10 feet of the slime must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking fire damage equal to the amount dealt to the slime on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

traits.name: Steaming
traits.description: If water touches the Orange Slime, a burning hot wave of steam erupts from it, filling the area within 20 feet. The area is heavily obscured until the end of the slime’s next turn or until a strong wind disperses it. This steam does not impede the vision of Orange and Yellow Slimes.

traits.name: Sulfurous Haze
traits.description: Creatures within 60 feet of the slime take a −5 penalty to ranged attack rolls against it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Orange Slime makes two Spike attacks and uses its Arrange.

actions.name: Arrange
actions.description: The Orange Slime attempts to pull a creature within 10 feet of it through its body and into another space. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 13 (3d8) fire damage and be moved to an unoccupied space within 15 feet of the slime.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The corrupted slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Sickness
traits.description: Each time a creature comes in contact with the corrupted slime, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion. Once a creature has been affected by a corrupted slime’s Sickness, it is immune for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Drain
actions.description: The corrupted slime deals 2 (1d4) necrotic damage to each creature affected by its sickness within 120 feet. It then regains hit points equal to the total damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The snowball spirits make two Pelt attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is at least one size smaller than the snowball spirits, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be whelmed.
actions.additional_effect: A whelmed creature is grappled (escape DC 14) and moves with the snowball spirits. A nearby creature may use an action and succeed on a DC 14 Strength check to free the grappled creature. The spirits can only whelm one creature at a time unless they are Huge, in which case they can whelm up to three.

actions.name: Snowball
actions.description: Whenever the snowball spirits take the Dash action, they can make a Slam attack as part of that action. Alternatively, if in snowy terrain, they may absorb snow during movement, grow by one size category, and regain 10 hit points.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: If the soda slime is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn’t observed the soda slime move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the soda slime isn’t an ordinary soda can.

traits.name: Soda Pop
traits.description: When a soda slime is reduced to 0 hit points, each creature within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or take 6 (1d10 + 1) force damage as it explodes in a fizzy pop.

traits.name: Sticky Nature
traits.description: The soda slime can occupy the same space as another creature. While in the same space as the soda slime, a creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity checks. When a creature leaves the soda slime’s space, it must first make a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check, carrying the slime with it on a failure.

reactions.name: Sticky Tendril
reactions.description: When a hostile creature’s movement provokes an opportunity attack from the soda slime, it forces the provoking creature to make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, causing it to fall prone on a failed save.

traits.name: Promising Threat
traits.description: The bestial spirit has advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks if the target has seen it hit a creature with its Chomp attack in the past minute.

actions.name: Chomp
actions.hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Devour
reactions.description: When the bestial spirit reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it consumes some of the creature’s essence, regaining 1d10 hit points.

traits.name: Distracting Maneuver
traits.description: When the Pest Spirit takes the Dash action, it doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks until the end of its turn.

traits.name: Hard to Catch
traits.description: The Pest Spirit has advantage on ability checks and saving throws against grapples and other effects that would impede its movement.

actions.name: Frustration
actions.description: The Pest Spirit interacts with a creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or the spirit gains inspiration.

traits.name: Earth Aquatic
traits.description: The stone whale can move through stone and earth as if they were difficult terrain.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.description: The stone whale can’t use its blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The stone whale can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.description: The stone whale has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

traits.name: Hallucinatory Chatter
traits.description: If a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the Stul and can hear it, the Stul can force the creature to make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw if the Stul isn’t incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed for 1 minute. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The effect ends early if it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it out of its stupor.

actions.name: Beckon
actions.description: The Stul commands any number of creatures charmed by its Hallucinatory Chatter to approach it. Each creature must spend its action on its next turn to move as close to the Stul as it can.

actions.name: Mental Invasion
actions.description: One creature the Stul chooses that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be forced to use its reaction to move its full speed in the opposite direction of the Stul.

name: Urugama
damage_resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Severed Body
traits.description: Urugama has four spectral bodies, each of which can take actions. These different bodies can’t move more than 100 feet away from each other, and Urugama divides its movement among its four bodies as it chooses.

traits.name: Shifting Form
traits.description: At the start of Urugama’s turn, one of its bodies is randomly selected as the true Urugama. Only the true body can take damage or suffer effects that round. The other bodies can be targeted but are unaffected and allow effects and attacks to pass through harmlessly.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two of Urugama’s forms make a spectral pass attack.

actions.name: Haunting Chuckle
actions.description: If at least three of Urugama’s bodies are within 20 feet of each other, they can release a haunting chuckle. All creatures within 30 feet of an Urugama body that can hear them must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion. On a failed save, the creature is immune to Urugama’s Haunting Chuckle for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Vespoma makes two
: one with its chomp and one with its claws.

actions.name: Master’s Voice
actions.description: The Vespoma can cast the *Command* spell at will, using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (save DC 12). The DC increases by 1 for each other Vespoma within 30 feet (maximum DC 20).

traits.name: Flammable
traits.description: The Vile Corruption is considered flammable and ignites as if it were a flammable object. If it takes more than 35 fire damage from a single attack or effect, or if it is on fire for 3 or more rounds, it explodes in a black ball of flames. Each creature within 20 feet must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The Vile Corruption has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The Vile Corruption can change its shape to match any beast, demon, elemental, monstrosity, or spirit at will. Its stats remain the same, and it retains a watery appearance.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Vile Corruption makes three
: one with its Bestial Bite and two with its Claw Mimicry.

actions.name: Bestial Bite
actions.additional_effect: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or have putrid water forced into their stomach, nullifying any potions currently affecting them.

actions.name: Avian Mimicry
actions.description: Waterlogged copies of songbirds burst forth toward up to 3 creatures within 30 feet. Each target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

name: Wandering Door
languages: understands all languages but can’t speak

traits.name: Dispel Susceptibility
traits.description: The Wandering Door becomes a mundane pile of rubble if it’s targeted by a Dispel Magic spell of 7th level or higher.

traits.name: Doorway
traits.description: A creature that enters the Wandering Door can teleport to any doorway on any plane. If unaware of its magic, they are teleported to a random doorway.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The Wandering Door is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (7/Day)
traits.description: If the Wandering Door fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Like the Wind
traits.description: The Wandering Door’s movement doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The Wandering Door has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Special Feet
traits.description: The Wandering Door can walk on all surfaces, including walls and water.

actions.name: Leap!
actions.description: The Wandering Door leaps 60 feet vertically into the air.

actions.name: Shake!
actions.description: The Wandering Door shakes violently. All creatures on top must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be thrown off, landing prone in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

reactions.name: Flee!!!
reactions.description: If a creature moves within 30 feet of the Wandering Door, it moves up to 100 feet away.

reactions.name: Shake!
reactions.description: When a creature lands on the Wandering Door, it shakes. All creatures on top must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be thrown off, landing prone within 10 feet.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: If the Watchwood Tree is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. If a creature hasn’t observed it move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that it isn’t an ordinary tree.

traits.name: Unruly Earth
traits.description: The ground within a 15-foot radius centered on the Watchwood Tree is difficult terrain for all creatures except the Watchwood Tree.

actions.name: Root Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon
: +4 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target.
: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Watching Eye (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Each creature of the Watchwood Tree’s choice within a 15-foot cone must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become restrained. A creature that can’t be frightened automatically succeeds. The Watchwood Tree can then immediately make a Root Slam attack against each creature that failed the saving throw. A restrained creature can use its action to make a DC 12 Wisdom check to end the effect.

traits.name: Coven Member
traits.description: The witch has advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks involving a witch coven.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon
: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature.
: 1 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The witch is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The witch has the following wizard spells

:

- Cantrips (at will): Light*, Mending*, Message*, Retrieve, Task
- 1st level (4 slots): Bubble Lift, Detect Magic*, Duplicate
- 2nd level (3 slots): Levitate*, Shared Vision

traits.name: Drum Line
traits.description: If the Yokario makes an attack against a creature that has been hit by one of its allies’ Drum Mallets since the end of the Yokario’s last turn, its Drum Mallet has an attack bonus of +6 instead of +4.

actions.name: Drum Mallet
actions.description: Melee Weapon
: +4 to hit (or +6 with Drum Line), reach 5 ft., one target.
: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.description: Ranged Weapon
: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target.
: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
